verdict.rationale: Luma is operated through natural-language prompts: text-to-video generation, messy or chained prompts handled natively without prompt engineering, and Luma Agents that research, generate and refine multi-step video and image workflows in the browser workspace. Community users confirm hands-on prompt-driven operation, though output fidelity varies. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how agents interpret natural-language commands to control the product beyond generation (e.g., managing projects or edits conversationally), and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent workflows.
